item_name: Rothco Thin Blue Line Mourning Arm Band
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Thin Blue Line Mourning Arm Band symbolizes the acknowledgement of a loss of a Police Officer's life.  Wear this band over your arm or badge as a symbol of respect and support for Law Enforcement Officials.
